rationale: The telemetry indicates that the robot experienced 3 line loss events and did not complete the race, suggesting that the controller needs to be adjusted to better handle the current geometry. I will implement a PID controller with tuned parameters to improve stability and responsiveness. The base speed will be set to 0.5, with kp = 1.0, ki = 0.1, and kd = 0.05. The sensor weights will be set to [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] to ensure equal contribution from all sensors. This should enhance the robot's ability to follow the line effectively and reduce line loss events in future trials.
